body:
Chief: heads-up on a collision you cannot see from your side. m1 is implementing bd-01M177SHFXZKMR8K39BPC9K6FF (cost blend carries its support) and its change moves two pinned literals in SignatureSuite.scala -- chronology 0.039516 and specificity 0.678220. You hold that file for the tolerance trio.

YOUR CLAMP MAY MOVE THE SAME TWO LITERALS FIRST, wherever the within-tolerance slack was actually being exercised. If it does, that is a real finding and not incidental: it would mean the slack was live on WOG rather than latent, which is the occurs question your bead says is unmeasured. So do not quietly re-pin them if they shift -- report what moved and by how much, because that measurement answers whether this defect was firing in production all along.

m1 will rebase onto whatever you land and re-measure against your tree rather than today's main. No action needed from you beyond saying what moved.
